build_FairseqNATModel: build a nonautoregressive transformer model using FairseqNATModel with custom encoder and decoder
build_FairseqNATEncoder: build a nonautoregressive encoder using FairseqNATEncoder with ensemble support for multiple models
build_FairseqNATDecoder: build a nonautoregressive decoder using FairseqNATDecoder with optional encoder attention disabled
use_ensemble_encoder: use the ensemble_encoder decorator to stack encoder outputs from multiple models
use_ensemble_decoder: use the ensemble_decoder decorator to ensemble decoder outputs with log-sum-exp normalization
